stories.headline: No bar on conducting byelection in Perundurai, Election Commission tells Madras High Court
stories.title: No bar on conducting byelection in Perundurai, Election Commission tells Madras High Court
stories.summary: It, however, adds that bypolls to Tiruchi East, Ambasamudram, Viralimalai and Karur will have to wait till disposal of connected election petitions
reasons: corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence
article_sentences: The legal bar for conduct of byelections in Perundurai Assembly constituency has ended due to the rejection of an election petition related to that constituency on September 8, 2026, the Election Commission of India (EC) has submitted before the Madras High Court.

In its written submissions filed in response to a public interest litigation petition pending before Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari and Justice G. Arul Murugan, the EC said the Perundurai bypoll could be conducted before November 24, 2026 if the Supreme Court does not grant any stay.

The EC said the conduct of bypoll would also be subject to the Chief Justice’s Bench exempting Perundurai from an interim order passed by it on July 10, 2026 restraining the commission from notifying bypolls to five vacant constituencies with respect to which election petitions were pending in the High Court.

In so far as the other four constituencies — Tiruchi East, Ambasamudram, Viralimalai and Karur — were concerned, the EC said the byelections cannot be notified to them until the election petitions, filed along with a plea to declare either those petitioners or other candidates as returned candidates, were decided.

Though Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay, who had vacated Tiruchi East and retained Perambur after winning from both the seats in the general elections, had contended that he resigned even before the filing of an election petition by DMK candidate S. Inigo Irudayaraj, the EC said the timing of the resignation was immaterial.

The Commission said it would not matter whether an election petition was filed either before or after the resignation because either way a constituency might end up facing an anomalous situation of being represented by two individuals if someone else gets declared as returned candidate by the election tribunal (High Court) after the conduct of bypolls.

Claiming that the deferment of bypolls was “neither indefinite nor indiscriminate,” the EC said the bar would come to an end immediately after the election tribunal disposes of a plea made along with an election petition to declare either the petitioner or some other candidate as returned candidate.

“This has already happened for Perundurai constituency,” the Commission said, and underlined that Section 86(7) of the Representation of People Act, 1951 requires every election petition to be disposed of as expeditiously as possible with an endeavour to conclude the trial within six months.
“The Commission fully recognises the importance of every constituency being represented...
The Commission would welcome any direction this court considers appropriate for the expeditious disposal ofthe pending election petitions,” the EC’s written submissions read.

stories.headline: Supreme Court Judges Not Meeting 'One Nation One Election' Committee
stories.title: Supreme Court Judges Not Meeting 'One Nation One Election' Committee
reasons: corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence
event term: 'supreme court' in title weight 44
article_sentences: The proposed meeting between the Joint Parliamentary Committee on 'One Nation, One Election' and Supreme Court judges will not take place, sources said.
The Committee had earlier proposed to meet the Chief Justice of India and Supreme Court Judges on October 6 for "informal discussions" on simultaneous elections.
However, the Supreme Court has declined the proposal of the Committee, according to sources.

Earlier in the day, Senior Advocate Kapil Sibal, in a press conference, had criticised the Committee's move to meet the Supreme Court judges by saying that it was a violation of the separation of powers.
Sibal stated that such a meeting had never happened in the history of the country.

The Joint Parliamentary Committee is examining the Constitution (One Hundred and Twenty-Ninth Amendment) Bill, 2024 and the Union Territories Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2024, which seek to facilitate simultaneous elections.

The committee, headed by BJP MP P.P. Chaudhary, has been conducting consultations with political parties, legislators, constitutional experts and other stakeholders as part of its examination of the two Bills.

The committee has previously stated that it has also consulted former Chief Justices of India, former Supreme Court judges and other legal experts on the constitutional implications of simultaneous elections.

stories.headline: President Murmu pays tribute to Mahatma Gandhi on eve of his 157th birth anniversary
stories.title: President Murmu pays tribute to Mahatma Gandhi on eve of his 157th birth anniversary
stories.summary: New Delhi [India], October 1 : On the eve of Mahatma Gandhi's 157th birth anniversary, President Droupadi Murmu paid tribute to him, saying his message of peace and non-violence holds vital relevance amid ongoing global conflicts. “On behalf of all citizens, I pay my respectful tribute to the Father of the Nation, Mahatma Gandhi, on his 157th birth anniversary, celebrated as Gandhi Jayanti,” the President said in her message on the eve of Gandhi Jayanti. According to the release, Murmu said Gandhi’s life and ideals are widely respected by the global community and noted that an atmosphere of war and conflict prevails in many parts of the world, affecting all nations. “In these circumstances, Mahatma Gandhi’s message of peace and non-violence becomes even more relevant,” she said. The President said India is advancing towards the national goal of becoming Viksit Bharat by 2047, with priority being given to the values of empathy and inclusion to ensure that no citizen is deprived of the benefits of development. She said this vision reflects the spirit of Mahatma Gandhi’s ideal of ‘Sarvodaya’, based on the principle of the welfare and upliftment of all. “On the auspicious occasion of Gandhi Jayanti, let us reaffirm our commitment to building an empowered, developed and Atmanirbhar Bharat through our ethical conduct and active participation,” Murmu said. Meanwhile, Union Minister for Coal and Mines G Kishan Reddy called for a nationwide 30-day cleanliness drive from Gandhi Jayanti on October 2 to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel's birth anniversary on October 31, urging citizens, government and private institutions, educational establishments, NGOs and other organisations to participate. Speaking to the media, Reddy said the cleanliness campaign should begin from people's homes and workplaces, with government and private offices, educational institutions, NGOs, associations and sanitation workers participating in the drive. "From Gandhi Jayanti to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel's birth anniversary, which is coming up on October 31st, for almost 30 days, everyone should take up this Swachh Bharat campaign program across the country, and an appeal has been made for everyone in the country to become participants," Reddy said. (ANI)

stories.title: Cabinet approves two instalments of DA, plans measures to tackle drought
stories.summary: State Cabinet decided to convene an all-party meeting soon and hold consultations with farmers’ associations and experts from different sectors before finalising the mitigation measures as the State recorded a rainfall deficit of about 17% during the monsoon, which ended on Wednesday, the Minister for Information Ponguleti Srinivas Reddy said

corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence

article_sentences: The State Cabinet has approved the release of two pending instaments of Dearness Allowance (DAs) to government employees and pensioners, said Minister for Revenue, Housing and Information and Public Relations Ponguleti Srinivasa Reddy.
“The Cabinet also decided to constitute a sub-committee to examine immediate measures to be taken in areas affected by the El Niño conditions.
It also resolved to convene an all-party meeting soon and hold consultations with farmers’ associations and experts from different sectors before finalising the mitigation measures.
The State government would also seek the Centre’s assistance and request the declaration of drought-affected areas,” he added.
Briefing the media after the Cabinet meeting chaired by Chief Minister.

A. Revanth Reddy at the Secretariat here on Thursday, the Minister said the two DAs would be released immediately from among the arrears pending since 2024, while the remaining arrears would be cleared in instalments.
“The release of DAs will impose an additional annual financial burden of about ₹2,500 crore on the State government.
Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy has decided to release the DA despite the financial burden, in line with the assurance given during recent discussions with employee unions,” he said.
The Cabinet also discussed the El Nino conditions and the deficient monsoon in the State.
Mr. Srinivasa Reddy said Telangana had recorded a rainfall deficit of about 17% during the monsoon, which ended on Wednesday.
The Cabinet also decided to make arrangements for procurement of paddy during the kharif season.
On power supply, Mr. Srinivasa Reddy said electricity consumption had increased significantly amid the prevailing conditions.

stories.headline: India set to grow 7.3 percent in Q2FY27: Finance Ministry
stories.title: India set to grow 7.3 percent in Q2FY27: Finance Ministry
stories.summary: India’s economy is likely to grow 7.3 percent in the July-September quarter of FY27, the Finance Ministry’s monthly economic review for September noted, signalling continued momentum despite a more “measured pace” than the record first quarter. The projection comes from the ministry’s nowcasting measure, unveiled in the Economic Survey earlier this year.The report notes that the slowdown shows up in several places. E-way bill generation and the manufacturing PMI have grown “more slowly”, IIP growth eased to 6.7 percent in July, core industries grew 4.8 percent, and kharif sowing is below last year’s level amid deficient monsoon rainfall, though pulses acreage rose. Price pressures have also intensified at the retail, wholesale and producer levels because of “renewed oil market pressure and weather volatility”, with food commodities and consumer electronics strained by El Niño risks and global DRAM chip prices.Externally, oil prices spiked in September, global bond yields have climbed sharply, the lower risk premium on Indian debt is weighing on the rupee, and the US Graham Bill, which allows tariffs of up to 100 percent on buyers of Russian crude, has left trade relations “unsettled”. Against this, services activity firmed in August, bank credit, electricity and fuel consumption and capital goods output remain healthy, exports are strong, and forex reserves of $765.9 billion offer a buffer.In addition, the report notes that “production of capital goods and infrastructure goods points to continued strength in the investment cycle. Automobile sales have grown at a healthy pace across rural and urban markets, underscoring the breadth of consumption”.Also Read: GST Collections Hit 5-Month High of Rs2.04 Lakh Crore in SeptemberStrong start to the yearReal GDP grew 7.8 percent in Q1 FY27, the highest first-quarter growth in the current series, while real GVA expanded 8.2 percent. Nominal GDP rose 10.3 percent. Investment hit its highest rate in the current series, and growth was broad-based across manufacturing, construction and services. Industry GVA grew 7.7 percent, with manufacturing up 9.2 percent.The report credits government steps to secure energy supplies and diversify import sources, along with limited pass-through of global energy prices to domestic fuel prices, for shielding activity from the West Asia conflict.Also Read: India GDP growth gets a wave of upgrades after robust Q1 showInflation, monsoon and farmsPrice pressures rose on renewed oil pressures and weather volatility, but about 69 percent of the goods in the inflation basket still show inflation well below the 4 percent target.Monsoon rainfall from June 1 to September 2 was 13 percent below normal. Kharif sowing stood at 1,086.31 lakh hectares on September 4 against 1,104 lakh hectares a year earlier, though pulses acreage rose. The major increase in area coverage has been reported in Uttar Pradesh, Jharkhand, Telangana, Rajasthan, Andhra Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh Reservoir storage is 70.29 percent of capacity, and groundwater remains largely stable as on September 3.Also Read: In numbers: How El Niño weighs on India's monsoonsGlobal headwindsThe report warns that global conditions have turned “unfavourable”. Oil prices spiked in September and global bond yields are climbing sharply. A lower risk premium on Indian debt is pressuring the rupee. The US Graham Bill, now law, lets the US President impose tariffs up to 100 percent on buyers of Russian crude.With the AI-driven investment cycle absorbing global capital and developed economies courting manufacturing investment, India faces stiff competition for inflows, though net FDI should improve this year.The report cautions that short-term pressure on Indian assets, including the rupee, will persist. With geopolitical and geoeconomic uncertainty running high, it says, India “cannot afford to rest on its post-Covid growth laurels”, because growth “has to be earned every quarter”.

stories.headline: Manipur Cabinet approves Rs 10 lakh aid for kin of 49 missing since 2023 violence
stories.title: Manipur Cabinet approves Rs 10 lakh aid for kin of 49 missing since 2023 violence
stories.summary: Manipur Cabinet approves Rs 10 lakh aid for kin of 49 missing since 2023 violence
reasons: corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence
event term: 'cabinet approves' in title weight 44
event term: 'cabinet approves' in summary weight 26.4
article_sentences: The Manipur Cabinet has approved Rs 10 lakh each for the families of 49 people still missing since the May 2023 violence.
The meeting also cleared higher ex-gratia for security personnel, a pension rise for retired journalists and the Fifth State Finance Commission.

The Manipur Cabinet on Thursday approved a one-time special humanitarian assistance of Rs 10 lakh each for the next of kin of 49 people who have remained missing since the violence that erupted in the state on May 3, 2023.
The 49 people remain untraced despite sustained search efforts.
The total financial implication of the assistance will be Rs 4.90 crore, which will be borne by the Manipur government.
The decision was among four key measures approved at the state Cabinet meeting held on Thursday.
The Cabinet also approved revised ex-gratia compensation for Army and Central Armed.
Police Forces (CAPF) personnel killed or injured in extremist violence or related actions while operating in Manipur.

Under the revised rates, Rs 10 lakh will be provided in case of death, while compensation for injuries has been fixed at Rs 2 lakh for permanent disability, Rs 1 lakh for grievous injury and Rs 20,000 for simple injury.
The earlier ex-gratia compensation was Rs 2 lakh in case of death and Rs 10,000 for injuries.
These rates had been fixed in 2006.
The Cabinet also approved an increase in the monthly pension for retired journalists under the Manipur Working Journalists' Pension Rules, 1996.

article_sentences: The Supreme Court on Thursday (October 1, 2026) stayed the execution of the death sentence awarded to an Indian Mujahideen operative in the 2008 Ahmedabad serial bomb blasts case, in which 56 people were killed.

A Bench of Justices Vikram Nath, A.G. Masih and Sandeep Mehta passed the interim order while hearing an appeal filed by Ahmed Bawa, alias Abbu Abubakar Barelvi, challenging the Gujarat High Court verdict affirming the death sentence imposed on him by the trial court.
The Bench issued notice to the Gujarat government and called for the trial court records, while directing that the death sentence not be executed in the meantime.
Appearing for Barelvi, his counsel contended that his conviction rested entirely on the allegation that he was part of the conspiracy behind the blasts.
“I have been convicted totally on the basis of conspiracy,” the counsel submitted.
Solicitor General Tushar Mehta, appearing for the Gujarat government, however, opposed the plea, stressing the gravity of the case.
“It is a serious case,” Mr. Mehta submitted.
On July 26, 2008, a series of 21 bomb blasts ripped through Ahmedabad within a span of 70 minutes, killing 56 people and injuring more than 200.
Explosions also occurred at hospitals where victims of the attacks were being taken for treatment.
On July 7, the Gujarat High Court upheld the death sentences awarded to 38 convicts in the case and the life sentences imposed on 11 others.

While upholding the capital punishment, the High Court cited the scale of the casualties, the “humongous nature of conspiracy” and the intention “to create an atmosphere of widespread terror in the society”.
It also took into account the roles and criminal antecedents of the convicts and their conduct during the trial.

stories.title: India-Pakistan clash confirmed for 2027 World Cup; what’s new in the tournament format

article_sentences: India and Pakistan will meet in the 2027 ODI World Cup group stage, with defending champions Australia also drawn into Group.
India and Pakistan will meet in the group stage of the 2027 ODI World Cup, with defending champions Australia also drawn into the same group for the tournament in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia.
The ICC revealed the 14-team World Cup groups on Thursday at the schedule launch in Cape Town, confirming a heavyweight Group.
A featuring India, Pakistan, Australia, Afghanistan, co-hosts Zimbabwe and the winner of Qualifier.
For cricket fans, the draw guarantees another India-Pakistan contest on the biggest stage.
India currently top the ODI rankings, while Shubman Gill will lead the team at his first ODI World Cup.
Who is in each World Cup group?
Ten teams have already qualified directly for the tournament.
They are India, Pakistan, Australia, Afghanistan, Bangladesh, England, New Zealand, Sri Lanka, South Africa and Zimbabwe.
The remaining places will be decided through the qualification process, with the final entrant into the main tournament coming from a new pre-tournament contest.
When will the 2027 ODI World Cup begin?
The World Cup will start on October 2, 2027, with the final scheduled for November 21.

stories.headline: NCLT approves Tata Steel merger with wholly owned subsidiary
stories.title: NCLT approves Tata Steel merger with wholly owned subsidiary
stories.summary: The Mumbai Bench of the tribunal has sanctioned Tata Steel’s amalgamation with Rujuvalika Investments, clearing the scheme proposed in 2024.
reasons: corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence
article_sentences: The National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Mumbai Bench, has approved and sanctioned the Scheme of Amalgamation between Tata Steel and its wholly owned subsidiary Rujuvalika Investments Ltd, along with their respective shareholders.
Tata Steel said the NCLT pronounced its order on October 1, 2026.
The scheme was proposed under Sections 230 to 232 and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013.
With the tribunal's order, the scheme of amalgamation has been approved and sanctioned, the company said.
The disclosure follows Tata Steel's earlier announcement dated July 31, 2024, regarding the proposed amalgamation.
The company has also submitted a copy of the NCLT order, as uploaded on the tribunal's website, to the stock exchanges.

In a separate development, Tata Steel had on Tuesday said it received a favourable order from the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) in a tax dispute, allowing its claim for deduction of interest expenditure.
The company said the order would reduce its tax exposure in the matter by around ₹427 crore, from ₹1,901 crore to ₹1,474 crore.
Separately, Tata Steel said it had received a favourable order dated February 20, 2026, from the relevant authority for FY2008, allowing its claim for deduction of interest expenditure.
The company said the tax exposure for FY2008 was ₹215 crore.
The company said it had made the required disclosure to the stock exchanges on February 28, 2026.
Following that order, Tata Steel said its tax exposure for FY2008 would fall from ₹1,901 crore to ₹1,686 crore, once the Assessing Officer gives effect to the order through a consequential order.

stories.headline: Mahindra, Embraer advance plans for C-390 military transport aircraft in India, pick Nagpur for assembly
stories.title: Mahindra, Embraer advance plans for C-390 military transport aircraft in India, pick Nagpur for assembly
stories.summary: Mahindra Group and Embraer are preparing an industrial and support ecosystem for the aircraft as they jointly pursue the Indian Air Force's Medium Transport Aircraft programme
reasons: source: event has 2 copies, primary source counted once
corroboration: 2 independent source groups -> high confidence
article_sentences: "The proposed facility would support the local assembly and industrialisation of the aircraft in India, subject to the Embraer C-390 Millennium being selected by the Government of India and an order being placed under the IAF’s MTA programme," the statement said.
Mahindra and Embraer said they are working with the Maharashtra government to complete the required processes and develop the industrial infrastructure needed for the programme.

"Mahindra is committed to building a globally competitive aerospace ecosystem in India and to creating meaningful manufacturing and technology capabilities that contribute to the country’s Atmanirbhar Bharat ambitions," said Vinod Sahay, Member of the Group Executive Board at Mahindra Group.
"As we work with Embraer on the C-390 Millennium, we are preparing the industrial ecosystem required to support the programme at scale.

Nagpur offers a compelling opportunity for such a capability, and we are very grateful to the Government of Maharashtra on expeditiously allotting the land in Nagpur and helping with the related requirements," he said.
Sahay added that the preparations remain subject to the selection of the C-390 Millennium and placement of the IAF order.
The proposed Nagpur facility would be a state-of-the-art site focused on aircraft assembly, system integration, manufacturing engineering, and local supply-chain development.
If the programme is awarded to the partnership, Mahindra and Embraer plan to progressively bring Indian aerospace companies into the C-390 Millennium ecosystem.
This would include manufacturing, aftermarket services, training, and lifecycle support.

"Embraer is pleased to deepen its partnership with Mahindra as we advance our preparations to bring the C-390 Millennium’s industrial capabilities to India," said Bosco da Costa Jr, President and CEO of Embraer Defense & Security.

"Identifying Nagpur as a potential location for an assembly facility is an important step in building a robust, long-term aerospace ecosystem in the country," he said, adding that the company valued the support of the Maharashtra government.
Embraer and Mahindra signed a Strategic Cooperation Agreement in October 2025 to jointly advance the C-390 Millennium for the IAF's MTA programme.
